experimental_method: Isopiestic comparison at 383-498 K of aqueous Li2SO4, Na2SO4, K2SO4, Cs2SO4 solutions with NaCl(aq) as reference electrolyte (duplicate samples, high-temperature isopiestic apparatus of earlier papers).
uncertainties_stated: molalities are averages of duplicate samples that rarely differ by more than 0.2 percent; average molality uncertainty less than 0.2 percent for the most dilute solutions; last digit not significant above 1.0 mol/kg; osmotic coefficient uncertainty about 0.005
quality_remarks: Printed values that look like misprints, kept as printed: 443.16 K row 1 left Li2SO4 1.5913 (neighbouring right half 2.5981); 443.16 K row 5 left K2SO4 1.4480 (right half 1.1504); 443.16 K row 3 right Na2SO4 1.91139 and K2SO4 1.79981 (five decimals); 473.17 K row 6 left Na2SO4 1.1275 (right half 2.2124, NaCl 1.7051); 383.14 K row 3 right half (NaCl 1.0196) is far from its left half. Data at 523.15 K were irreversible and are not reported. The OCR text layer of this scan was unreliable (dropped cells, wrong digits), so the whole table was read from the 300 dpi image.

not_extracted_tables.reason: Cs2SO4 vs NaCl-reference isopiestic molalities only (higher Cs2SO4 range); no in-scope sulfate. NaCl is only the isopiestic reference. Not transcribed; could be added if reference-NaCl data are wanted.
